title: CDC milestone pages are not a substitute for a validated screening tool
summary: The CDC says its Learn the Signs materials are not a substitute for standardized, validated developmental screening tools.
body: The CDC 2-month milestone page says, under keep in mind, that Learn the Signs. Act Early. materials are not a substitute for standardized, validated developmental screening tools. A checklist item is a prompt for a conversation with a clinician. It is not itself the screening instrument the page names. The page still says not to wait if a baby is missing a milestone, has lost a skill, or the caregiver is worried: talk with the doctor and ask about screening. That wording is the United States program's own limit on its materials.
